title: Wallet + Energy
one_line: What the + on each top-bar pill opens. Two popups, one builder, one purpose: sell coins and energy without a separate inventory screen.

anatomy.spec: Standard NX Card, nameplate COINS, current balance as a hero number, coin tiers (bible 5.17-style small cards) each a price button.
Standard NX Card, nameplate ENERGY, current/max with the regen bar (bible 5.12) and 'Next in M:SS', energy tiers as small cards, and if ads are in scope a WATCH AD (option) for +3.

states: Energy full - hide the regen bar and 'Next in' entirely
data: RevenueCat/coin-pack IAP for tiers, once T-B3 ships. Coin packs can be server-granted virtual currency, not necessarily real-money.
do_not: Do not build a separate full inventory screen - these two popups plus the shop are the whole economy surface.
Do not show a regen bar when energy is already full.
acceptance: Opens from every pill + across every hub.
Regen countdown is accurate and hides at full.
steps: 2. Rebuild both popups on the standard NX Card chassis.
3. Wire balances and regen math to the real services.
4. Wire tiers to IAP/grants once available; placeholder tiles until then.
5. Capture both, full and regenerating. Postflight.
prompt:
Polish the Ludo NX Wallet and Energy popups.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md sections 5.12 and 5.13, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

These are what the + button on each top-bar pill opens. Standard NX Card chassis for both: COINS shows the balance as a hero number plus coin-tier tiles; ENERGY shows current/max with a regen progress bar and a 'Next in M:SS' line (hidden entirely once full), plus energy-tier tiles and, if ads are in scope, a WATCH AD option for +3.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
